Subject: QA eval synopsis + rollout asks for promptset A/B

Team / Priya —

We kicked off the promptset A/B pass last week; thanks to Priya and BetaCorp for the quick data. I pulled a short synopsis of outcomes from the first automated sweep (attached logs). Before we go into a staged rollout, I need alignment on three product asks from PD and PM:

1) Acceptance criteria matrix — what concrete metrics will mark A vs B as acceptable (latency, hallucination rate, slot accuracy, safety flags).
2) Rollout plan — can we safely do a 10/90 canary with auto-fallback, and what are the gating checks for expanding to 50/50?
3) Exception handling — if we detect a quality regression in the top 1% of traffic, what is the immediate rollback process and who owns comms?

Attachments: promptsetA_v3.csv; AB_plan_matrix_20270614.xlsx; eval-run-logs.tar.gz

Marissa/Rishi/Karthik/Dev — please respond with suggested acceptance thresholds and a simple A/B rollout matrix by EOD Friday. Priya — if Acme has any regulatory constraints we should account for in the gating, flag them here.

Thanks,
Markus
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QA eval synopsis + rollout asks for promptset A/B

Thanks Markus — quick first pass from product/PM perspective:

Acceptance criteria (proposal):
- Latency: 95th percentile token latency not worse than +10% vs control.
- Safety: no increase in safety flags >= 0.1 percentage point on the curated safety promptset.
- Precision (slot-filling): macro F1 >= 0.92 on the labeled validation set.
- Regression delta: any single intent with >3% absolute drop triggers investigation.

Rollout plan (proposal):
- Phase 0: internal preview (10% internal traffic) for 48 hours.
- Phase 1: 10% external (canary) for 24-48 hours with realtime monitoring and auto-fallback on safety or precision breaches.
- Phase 2: 50/50 for 72 hours if Phase 1 passes.
- Phase 3: full rollout with continued sampling and weekly checks.

Exception / comms:
- Owner: Rishi (on-call for evals) — immediate rollback and postmortem.
- Comms: Customer-facing note drafted by AM (Markus) + ops blameless incident doc.

I'll attach a condensed acceptance matrix to the Drive link and update AB_plan_matrix.

-Marissa
Senior PM, Evals
Redwood Inference

To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QA eval synopsis + rollout asks for promptset A/B

Thanks — that looks reasonable. A couple of asks from Acme side: 

- Can we add a data-retention check to the gating? Acme needs a 30-day soft-delete buffer for sampled user outputs (drive link would be fine).
- For the canary, if you do auto-fallback, can we get an immediate webhook/incident event to our integration so we can pause downstream processes?

Also, small note: our legal required that any rollback within 24 hours triggers a joint postmortem within 72 hours — happy to share the legal playbook.

Best,
Priya Shah
Head of Integrations
Acme AI
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QA eval synopsis + rollout asks for promptset A/B

Folks — technical plan and quick notes from infra/evals: 

A/B execution details:
- Canary routing: we can do 10% via traffic-split policy with immediate KV-cache separation.
- Auto-fallback triggers: safety flag spike >0.1pp, macro F1 drop >0.03, latency p95 delta > +20%.
- Webhook: will emit a signed JSON payload to Acme's endpoint on fallback; need Priya to confirm URL and auth method.

Monitoring & rollbacks:
- We will keep a 5-minute sliding window for the critical metrics and a 60-minute aggregated check for sustained regression.
- Rollback is handled by the routing component and will surface an incident in PagerDuty; ops owner rotates weekly.

Data retention / compliance:
- Implementing a 30-day soft-delete buffer for sampled outputs is feasible; will add to plan and call out encryption in transit + at rest.

I updated the AB_plan_matrix_20270614.xlsx with specific metric thresholds and the automated actions column. Linking to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPromptsetA

Rishi
Lead, Inference Evals
Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — summary and actions (finalizing for exec):

Decisions:
- Acceptance criteria set per Marissa's proposal with adjusted thresholds from Rishi's tuned numbers in the Drive doc.
- Canary pattern: 10% external for 48 hours, auto-fallback enabled, webhook to Acme on fallback.
- Data retention: 30-day soft-delete for sampled outputs; Dev to confirm encryption logs.

Owners / next steps: 
- Rishi: finalize monitoring playbook + PagerDuty runbook (due 2027-06-25).
- Dev: confirm soft-delete implementation and keys (due 2027-06-24).
- Marissa: prepare customer-facing rollout note and the acceptance matrix (due 2027-06-22).
- Markus: draft executive summary and legal ops note for Acme (due 2027-06-23).

If there are no objections by end of week I will publish the rollout calendar and schedule the internal preview for 2027-06-28.

-Markus
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
